o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آند ایچمك.

From Proto-Turkic *bakïr (“copper”).
Cognate with
Old Turkic [script needed] (baqïr),
Karachay-Balkar, Kumyk багъыр (bağır),
Kyrgyz, Tatar бакыр (baqır),
Crimean Tatar baqır, Turkish bakır (“copper”);
Kazakh бақыр (baqır, “copper coin”),
Uzbek paqir,
Southern Altai бакрас (bakras, “copper kettle”),
Yakut баҕарах (bağaraq, “kettle, pot”), etc.
